messages:
elaine (People Ops): Quick policy check — we have a new hire starting Thu and the rest of the team is taking Wed–Fri as a partial-week holiday. How do we pro-rate the observed day and floating-holiday eligibility for someone who joins mid-week? Do we need any special payroll flags before the cutoff?

sam (Eng): Do they get the company observed day even if they start on Thu? or is it pro-rated to hours worked that week?

jess (New Hire): hi! I start Thu morning — wanted to confirm before I submit anything in Workday. :)

mike (Manager): I need to know if I should approve a partial-day PTO for Wed for the rest of the team and leave Jess unpaid for Wed or put her on holiday so benefits kick in correctly. Payroll deadline is Friday am for our region right?

elaine (People Ops): Short answer: we pro-rate accruals based on start date in the first pay period. For company-wide observed holidays, new hires who start on or before the holiday are eligible for that paid holiday; if they start after, it's not retroactive. For mid-week hires: if Jess's start date is Thu 12:00 AM (official start in HR), she would be eligible for Thu/Fri observed days but not Wed.

elaine (People Ops): Floating holidays follow the standard eligibility window: employees earn access after 60 days (not 90) for US and EU hires; if you need an exception for day-0 credit, that requires manager + People Ops approval and is documented.

toni (HR): To be explicit about payroll flags: if you want the new hire to be paid for a day they didn't work (e.g., to align with the team's holiday), tag the hire in Workday as "Holiday Credit: Yes" before the payroll cutoff. Payroll-bot will surface the tag if it's set. If left blank, payroll treats them as not eligible and will pay according to recorded time/PTO.

mike (Manager): Understood. What's the deadline for that tag?

toni (HR): Payroll cutoff for this pay period is Thu 08:00 PT. If you need People Ops to approve a day-0 holiday credit, DM me and cc payroll. After cutoff we can still fix via off-cycle adjustments but that'll show as a separate line item on the next check.

sam (Eng): Is there a quick checklist for managers? Can we just add it to the offer/boarding steps so we don't scramble?

elaine (People Ops): Yes — suggested manager checklist: 1) confirm start date in offer letter, 2) if start falls on/after company holiday decide whether to grant holiday credit, 3) set "Holiday Credit" flag in Workday before payroll cutoff, 4) if offering exception, get email approval from People Ops (elaine) + Toni and attach to employee file. I'll paste the one-pager below.

elaine (People Ops): ```Manager checklist:
- Confirm official start date
- Decide holiday credit eligibility
- Set Workday flag: Holiday Credit: Yes/No
- Get People Ops + HR approval for exceptions
- Notify payroll before cutoff (payroll@redwood.com)
```

payroll-bot: Reminder — payroll cutoff Thu 08:00 PT. Set Workday flags or submit exceptions before cutoff to avoid off-cycle adjustments. :bell:

mike (Manager): Thanks — I'll set the flag and DM for the exception just in case. :thumbsup:

jess (New Hire): Thanks everyone — appreciate the clarity. I'll hold off on submitting anything until Mike confirms. :smile:

elaine (People Ops): If anyone wants me to pre-check the Workday flag this afternoon, ping me and I'll confirm it's set.
